system.description:
Size Small • Speed 25ft • Darkvision 120ft • +2 Int / +1 Wis, −1 Cha

Traits

  • Advantage on Stealth in stone/rocky terrain.
  • Innate Nondetection: always on, you can't be found by divination magic.
  • Innate Blindness/Deafness: 1/day (Fortitude save, Ancestry Save DC, Constitution).
  • Advantage on Will saves vs magic.
  • Weapon training: dagger, light hammer, heavy pick, hand crossbow.
